messages:
olivia: Heads up — finance noticed ~27 invoices that now have an extra zero-amount credit line showing in NetSuite export. Appears harmless amount-wise but it's breaking downstream CSV imports and causing line-numbering confusion for accounting. Cluster around 2026-03-22 07:10-07:40 UTC.

raj: Any pattern on which invoices? Are these newly created credits or artifacts of a backfill?

billing-bot: [auto] anomaly-detect count=27 type=zero_amount_creditline window=2026-03-22T07:05..2026-03-22T07:45 sample=[in_2Ght9,in_7Klp0]

olivia: Sample: Stripe shows a $45.00 credit applied. NetSuite now shows two credit lines: one for $45.00, one for $0.00 added immediately after. The zero line has no attached memo and an internal memo field "ghost_serial": true.

netops: We just shipped ns-sdk@3.2.0 yesterday which changed XML serialization for optional money fields. Could be related.

raj: Who owns the NS apply path? payments-team or ns-sync? I think ns-sync calls the SDK when writing credit lines.

olivia: ns-sync. The apply worker logs show successful POST to NS but we assumed success. Maybe NS accepted a partial payload and created an extra line.

netops: Quick grep in canary logs for ghost_serial: `rg "ghost_serial" -n /var/log/ns-sync/* | head` -> found 29 entries with matching invoice IDs. That aligns. The SDK appears to add an empty <amount>0</amount> tag when a money field is null. NetSuite treats that as a valid zero-dollar line.

raj: Not good. Two action items: 1) stop further writes by toggling ns-sync into read-only or pause applies, 2) backfill fixes to remove zero lines or collapse them with the real credit. Which is safer?

accounting: We prefer not to delete anything blindly. If the zero-line is non-substantive we can reverse it with a memo explaining automated cleanup, but we need a full audit trail. Finance wants a dry-run of any removal job first.

netops: I'll toggle ns-sync.apply.enabled=false in prod for a short window. Then we can reason about a script to remove zero lines that are immediate neighbors to a non-zero credit and that have ghost_serial=true metadata.

billing-bot: [auto] ns-sync.apply.enabled toggled=false by netops at 2026-03-22T08:02:15Z

olivia: Extracting affected invoice list and attaching to drive: s3://redwood-prod/replay/ghostlines/2026-03-22/invoice_list.csv. I also pulled sample NS XML payloads showing the empty <amount> tags.

raj: Proposed backfill dry-run steps: 1) pull NS transactions for the invoice range 2) identify zero-lines where memo contains ghost_serial or created_by=ns-sdk-3.2.0 3) for each candidate, if there is an adjacent non-zero credit with same credit_id prefix, annotate and propose removal -> write CSV 4) accounting review.

olivia: Dry-run script: `python tools/find_ghost_lines.py --from 2026-03-22T07:00 --to 2026-03-22T08:00 --output ./dryrun_ghosts.csv` produced 27 candidates. Sample row: `in_2Ght9,re_9ab12,ns_line_772,0.00,ghost_serial=true,adjacent_ns_line=771,adjacent_amount=45.00`.

accounting: We'll review dryrun CSV and flag any invoice where the zero-line might be intentional (rare). Should take ~1.5h.

support: For customers: do we notify? If there's no balance change we usually don't, but if exports failed or they contacted support we should send a note. Finance to decide.

raj: While accounting reviews, I'll open a patch in ns-sdk to stop serializing empty money tags. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/5899 - change is small: skip <amount> when None. Also adding unit test.

netops: Also add a temporary safeguard in ns-sync to filter out zero-dollar credit lines with ghost_serial metadata at write-time so we don't create more. That will be reversible. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/5901

billing-bot: [auto] filter-safeguard deployed to canary by netops at 2026-03-22T08:35:02Z

olivia: Accounting finished review: 25 clear candidates approved for removal; 2 invoices require manual check because the zero-line was intentionally used as a placeholder for deferred adjustment. Accounting annotated the CSV (s3://redwood-prod/replay/ghostlines/2026-03-22/approved.csv).

raj: Running dry-run removal (no-op) to show net effect: `python tools/remove_zero_lines.py --input approved.csv --dry-run --annotate=ghostline_fix_2026_03_22` -> output ./dryrun_effects.csv shows 25 lines would be removed, total no-change in balances.

accounting: Approve actual removal for the 25. For the 2 manual ones we'll handle with accounting adjustments. Please include a reversal entry and notes for audit.

billing-bot: [auto] cleanup-job queued job_id=ghost_fix_208 queued_by=raj eta=2026-03-22T10:00:00Z

netops: Quick checklist before run: (1) snapshot NS transactions for the invoices (done to s3://redwood-prod/backups/ghostlines/2026-03-22/), (2) ensure replay logs annotate original stripe_event_id and ns_txn_id.

billing-bot: [auto] cleanup-job started job_id=ghost_fix_208 status=running

billing-bot: [auto] cleanup-job completed job_id=ghost_fix_208 removed=25 memos_created=0 failures=0 duration=00:06:17 artifacts=s3://redwood-prod/replay/ghostlines/2026-03-22/applies.csv

olivia: Verified NetSuite exports post-cleanup — CSV imports that were failing now parse fine. Accounting confirmed totals match Stripe. Uploaded final artifact and audit notes.

raj: Merged ns-sdk patch to main (PR 5899) and will cut a hotfix release ns-sdk@3.2.1. Shim PR 5901 merged and deployed to prod to filter zero-lines until SDK lands. I'll schedule a retro to ensure SDK serialization changes are flagged in billing release notes.

netops: ns-sdk@3.2.1 hotfix released at 2026-03-22T12:00:05Z. ns-sync.apply.enabled toggled=true by netops at 2026-03-22T12:05:10Z

accounting: All reconciled. Please attach the audit CSV to the monthly billing packet and note the automated cleanup.

support: I'll prepare a FAQ entry for support cases in case customers ask about unexpected zero lines.

olivia: Thanks team — good catch and clean run. I'll write the postmortem and link artifacts. Closing when PM reviews the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
